messages:
Maya CSM: Hey team — prepping a concise stakeholder brief + action tracker for Acme post-onboarding. Need exec sign-off before Wed EOD. Draft below, please add gaps + owners. TL;DR: adoption looks healthy, renewal risk on usage tier, some enablement follow-ups outstanding.

Sam AE: Thanks Maya. Can you add a high-level renewal ask? Exec will want a $ ask and timeline.

Maya CSM: Added a renewal ask placeholder $100k ARR with milestones (Q3 upsell pilot -> Q4 commit). Can someone confirm renewal owner and final pricing?

Jenna (Success Ops): I'll pull the enablement completion report by EOD. FYI 28% of seats haven't finished advanced training.

Oliver CSD: We should call out two operational blockers: SSO latency spike last week and custom-embed rate limits. I'll own escalation with eng; need logs and incident ticket.

Sam AE: I'll loop in the customer's CFO for exec alignment. Also want a one-slide ROI snapshot: tokens saved via caching + 3-month cost savings estimate.

Maya CSM: Draft slide snippets below — please suggest edits: 
```
Slide 3: Adoption metrics - DAU: 1.2k, Active seats: 420, Avg session tokens: 8.1k
Slide 5: Risk map - Usage tier drift -> renewal exposure (low/med/high)
Slide 7: Asks: commitment tier, pilot expansion, executive sponsor
```
Change suggestions welcome.

Oliver CSD: Wording looks good. Recommend 'commitment tier' instead of 'price' — less tactical and easier for execs.

Jenna (Success Ops): Enablement next steps: @Maya send follow-up email template, @Oliver schedule a 30m mini-training for power users, I'll create a progress dashboard showing completion by role.

Maya CSM: Will send the email template by 4pm today. Draft subject: "Next steps: Acme enablement + exec briefing".

Sam AE: CFO confirmed availability Tue 10am PT for a 30m exec sync. Can we aim to finalize brief by Mon noon?

Maya CSM: Target Mon noon. Quick inline action tracker (CSV):
```
owners,task,due
Maya CSM,send enablement email,today 4pm
Jenna (Success Ops),enablement dashboard,Mon 9am
Oliver CSD,eng escalation for SSO,ASAP
Sam AE,confirm pricing & secure CFO invite,Thu EOD
```
I'll update the deck after edits and attach.

Oliver CSD: I'll add notes from the customer exec call and attach a one-pager summary in the drive.

ops-bot: Deck uploaded to Drive -> https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/placeholder-acme-brief (permissions: internal + Acme execs).

Sam AE: Quick ask — can design create a single-slide visual for "value realized" (before/after latency & cost)? If yes, I'll drop examples in the drive.

Maya CSM: Thanks everyone — please add any final edits directly in the slide deck. I'll own assembly and send final to execs by Mon noon. :thumbsup:
